names: a paid build reads every earnings call on file or spends nothing: a call that does not read refuses the build before its first model call, where it was left out and flagged after the spend (VRRM run 6043fb83 read 1 of 2 calls for $5.15); each LibreOffice conversion runs under a user profile of its own, removed after, so two conversions at once no longer lose one, and one still running at 120 s is killed with every process it started and is a call that did not read.
